in_sanskrit.name: बासंत
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Basant' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vasanta', which means 'Spring' or 'the season of Spring'. It is the name of the Hindu god of Spring, represented as the youthful, handsome, and energetic deity of the season.

in_tamil.name: பாசந்த
